full_judgment: 3. It is stated that the Local Government Division vide a letter dated 23.01.2012 asked to take necessary information to with regard to allegation where any violation of rule in appointment of him was done. The Chief Executive Officer, Madaripur in reply to the letter dated 23.01.2012 under Memo No Je Pa Ma/ 21/2012/143 dated 12.04.2012 mentioned that his appointment to the said post was done prior to promulgation of Zilla Parishad Ain, 1990. After completion of 10 years in Service of Zilla Parishad, on scrutiny of the records for the last 10 years, he was given appointment as Administrative Officer in the year of 2001. He also opined that after passing of long 23 years in service there should not be any step taken against that appointment. Moreover the authority did not specify that whether his appointment would create punishment major or minor. In the absence of clarifying all those things mentioning of his appointment as illegal is a malafide action and thus the impugned letter is liable to be declared to have been made without any lawful authority and to be of no legal effect.
